title: A reusable deployment description
summary: Complete a local deployment description: one existing resource group location becomes a named output. Compile only; this deploys nothing.

input.clue: Declaration keyword for a caller-supplied deployment value

value.clue: Name of the input referenced by the output expression

result.clue: Declaration keyword for a value returned by a deployment

inputType.clue: Parameter type for a location name expressed as text

scope.clue: Function returning the current deployment group’s metadata

outputType.clue: Output type for the returned location name
